🎭 Let's not argue about crowd sizes. Let's judge each crowd by the OFFENCES — the honest measure the media refuses to apply evenly.

👉 Notting Hill Carnival: 7,000+ police officers, 240+ arrests on the FIRST DAY alone — weapons, drugs, sexual offences, multiple stabbings, and 55 arrests for assaulting police officers.
The coverage? "Mood overwhelmingly positive." A triumph.

👉 A large political march last September: around 25 arrests, majority entirely peaceful.
The coverage? "Far-right." Every bulletin. Every front page.

Count the crimes, not the excuses. Far MORE offending — stabbings, sex offences, 55 assaults on police — reported as a success. Far LESS offending reported as a threat to the nation.

And here's the fair bit: the overwhelming majority at BOTH events committed no crime at all. So apply ONE standard. If you judge one crowd by its worst few, judge both that way.

Reform UK: one standard, for everyone. Report the offences honestly wherever they happen. Back our police at every event. And drop the selective "far-right" branding.

Read the full piece 👇
